context:
Goal: every page the roadmap links to opens for you, and its content is kept in git.
Problem (goal): the artifact lane found that 8 of the 9 pages the roadmap links live in another Claude account, so this account cannot read or export them; only you can reach that account.
Based on (read): artifact lane check, reported by the coordinator Nov 3 17:37 CST.
Based on (read): the artifact lane's goal is git as every artifact's home (feedback fb-1456-1).
Departs from: the roadmap, which links the 8 pages as if this account holds them — each option changes how they are kept.

options.gain: No work for you; the links keep working where you are signed in.
options.how: The artifact lane marks the 8 pages as living in another account, with no export; the links stay.
options.label: Register as other
options.lose: Their content stays out of git.

options.gain: The roadmap links only pages this account holds.
options.how: The lane removes the 8 links from the roadmap.
options.label: Drop the links
options.lose: You lose the path to those pages from the roadmap.

options.gain: Every page's content is in git.
options.how: You sign in to the other account and export each page; the lane commits the files.
options.label: Re-export into git
options.lose: Your time in the other account, 8 pages.

title: 8 of 9 roadmap-linked pages live in another Claude account: register them as other, drop the links, or re-export them into git?
why: It costs you nothing now, and the pages stay reachable; an export can follow later.
